label: Workforce

projection.consumedFor: source-derived agent status, role/runtime, permission profile, last-seen observation, assignments, runs, capability coverage, demand, and typed gaps

derivation.agents: one canonical card per exact agentId; duplicate winners compare only explicit scene fields with code-unit ordering
derivation.tasks: exact assigned-to task-to-agent edges plus resolving canonical activeTaskIds; disagreement is an assignment-contradiction gap
derivation.runs: exact executes agent-to-run edges; the code-unit-smallest valid canonical agent wins and invalid edges never block valid edges
derivation.capabilities: exact canonical eligibleAgentIds and skillIds compared with exact requires-cluster task demand
derivation.load: resolved active assignment count only; never productivity, ranking, utilization, or performance

density.overflow: fail closed or render a bounded explicit unknown/truncated state

authority.governedActions: Proposal flow deferred to Task 11; this scene has no write fetch, handler, submit behavior, registry/runtime/task-store call, or authority decision

browserParity: WORKFORCE_BROWSER_JS is explicit browser-valid source composed into the single boot IIFE; Node and browser observable HTML is byte-identical
redaction: Every projection-derived value is bounded and escaped. Secret grammar covers query_id=, auth_date=, word-boundary hash=, Bearer whitespace, bot_token, clientSecret, initData, TELEGRAM_INIT_DATA, TG_INIT_DATA, QUESTS_PUSH_TOKEN, token=, PRIVATE KEY, prompt assignment, and prompt injection. Source/evidence payloads, digests, credentials, Telegram auth, private client data, and hostile raw IDs never render.
